verses.1: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples
verses.2: and said to them, "Go into the village in front of you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
verses.3: If anyone says to you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord has need of it and will send it back here at once.'"
verses.4: And they went and found a colt tied at a door outside in the street, and they untied it.
verses.5: And some of those standing there said to them, "What are you doing, untying the colt?"
verses.6: And they told them what Jesus had said, and they let them go.
verses.7: And they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and He sat on it.
verses.8: And many spread their garments on the road, and others spread leafy branches that they had cut from the fields.
verses.9: And those who went before and those who followed were crying out, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
verses.10: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.11: And He entered Jerusalem and went into the temple. And when He had looked around at everything, as it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.
verses.12: On the following day, when they came from Bethany, He was hungry.
verses.13: And seeing a fig tree in the distance with leaves, He went to see if He could find anything on it. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.14: And He said to it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again." And His disciples heard it.
verses.15: And they came to Jerusalem. And He entered the temple and began to drive out those who were selling and those who were buying in the temple, and He overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
verses.16: And He would not allow anyone to carry goods through the temple.
verses.17: And He was teaching them and saying, "Is it not written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations'? But you have made it a den of robbers."
verses.18: And the chief priests and the scribes heard it and were seeking a way to destroy Him, for they feared Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.
verses.19: And when evening came, they went out of the city.
verses.20: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered to its roots.
verses.21: And Peter remembered and said to Him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree that you cursed has withered."
verses.22: And Jesus answered them, "Have faith in God.
verses.23: Truly I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart but believes that what he says will come to pass, it will be done for him.
verses.24: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
verses.25: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses."
verses.26: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.27: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to Him,
verses.28: and said to Him, "By what authority are you doing these things, or who gave you this authority to do them?"
verses.29: Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question. Answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.30: Was the baptism of John from heaven or from men? Answer Me."
verses.31: And they discussed it with one another, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'
verses.32: But if we say, 'From men' —" they feared the people, for everyone considered John to truly have been a prophet.
verses.33: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know." And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
